metadata.latency_clock: perf_counter immediately after output-producing engine step; sampling .tolist synchronizes outputs
metadata.step_trace_clock: host engine.step return times; zero-output prefill steps may still have GPU work pending
metadata.timestamp_units: seconds relative to measured run start
metadata.long_prefill_completion_definition: first long-request output token at step completion (includes sampling)
metadata.warmup: full identical workload rehearsal; reset prefix metadata and reseed before timing
metadata.kernel_note: use_triton=False disables optional fused kernels; KV store and torch.compile may use Triton
